''See also: [[Felrex Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[King Regent|King Regent Felrex]] is a ruler who governs from the royal palace on [[Karosha]]. A former member of [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]]'s family, he rose to power by using his status as a [[Perfected]] to gather support for a betrayal against her. He maintains control through the use of the [[Karoshan fleet]] and an army known as [[The Perfected|the Perfected]], which includes mages capable of performing grand rituals. Felrex utilizes these forces to defend his territory and stall enemies like the [[D’Niss|D'Niss]] while he works toward total galactic dominance. His leadership is characterized by a belief that time is his ally, as he seeks to expand his military strength and resources through research facilities and the production of more [[Perfected]]. He is often depicted as a confident and certain leader, though he has been known to experience periods of extreme lethargy.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Felrex is a member of [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]]'s family, and his presence causes [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]]'s children to hide. He is also a figure mentioned by [[Tythalia]] in discussions concerning colonist loyalty, while [[Prince Veshran|Veshran]] has maintained independence from him.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Shyrax Family History}} ===
